name: SNED Nature Picture Ratings
description: Faithful replication of the Salford Nature Environments Database (SNED) rating study (Bendall et al., 2024, Behavior Research Methods), with the authors' 500 CC0 pictures: 435 nature scenes (water, woodland, desert, field, mountain, snow, managed landscape, cave) and 65 urban control scenes. Each participant gets one of the paper's 10 overlapping sets of 100 pictures (every picture is in two sets), in an order where no category appears three times in a row. Each picture fills the screen for 3 s, then is rated on eight 9-point bipolar scales in a fixed order: arousal, valence, approach/avoidance, pleasantness, familiarity, mystery, interest and prospect/refuge. Before the task: age, gender, education, nationality, the MacArthur social ladder and the rural-to-urban scale (where you live, are now, spend most time; liking urban and rural leisure). Three awareness checks ask whether a picture contained a car. About one hour. Differences from the original study: (1) the set (1-10) is drawn at random per participant instead of a hard-coded allocation; (2) the 9-point scales are tapped as buttons instead of dragged sliders; (3) ethnicity and place of birth are not asked; (4) the car checks reuse a picture the participant has just rated (an urban control picture at checks 1 and 3, a nature picture at check 2), because the paper does not list its check pictures; (5) pictures are resized from 1920 to 1440 px wide; (6) phones are allowed, the original was computer-only. Each rating record's key is the SNED ImageTitle, so results can be compared directly with the published norms (Data_ImageLevel_AgregateRatingsAndCalculatedProperties.csv, OSF qm42t).
author: Bendall et al.

elements.name: consent
elements.title: I agree to take part. Participation is voluntary and my answers are recorded anonymously for research.

elements.name: social_ladder
elements.title: Think of a ladder with 10 rungs. It represents where people stand in society. At the top (10) are the people who are best off: those with the most money, most education and best jobs. At the bottom (1) are the people who are worst off: those with the least money, least education and worst jobs or no job. Where do you think you stand on the ladder?

elements.name: rural_urban

rows.text: Where do you spend most of your time?

elements.title: On a scale from 1 to 10, where 1 is an isolated place in the country, 6 is in the suburbs and 10 is in the middle of a city:

elements.name: leisure

rows.text: How much do you like to spend your leisure time in an urban environment?
How much do you like to spend your leisure time in a rural environment?

elements.title: On a scale from 1 (do not like) to 10 (like very much):

elements.name: image_set
elements.title: Image set shown to this participant (1–10, the paper's set lists)
elements.description: Assigned at random by the page when the rating task starts.

elements.name: ratings
elements.title: Rate this picture

dimensions.label: Looking at this picture makes me feel …
My reaction to this picture is …
I find looking at this picture …
The environment in this picture feels …
If I was to further explore the environment in this picture, I think there would be …

elements.description: One record per picture: key = SNED ImageTitle (e.g. cave_001), shown = the picture file (ImagePath in Data_ImageLevel_AgregateRatingsAndCalculatedProperties.csv on OSF qm42t). Values 1–9 on the paper's eight bipolar scales, always in the same order.

elements.name: awareness_checks
elements.title: Awareness checks: does the picture contain a car?
elements.description: Three checks, after pictures 25, 50 and 75. One record per check: key = after_25 / after_50 / after_75, value = { after, image: SNED ImageTitle, file, answer: 'yes' | 'no' }, shown = the picture. The picture is one the participant has already rated: an urban control picture at checks 1 and 3 when the set has one, a nature picture at check 2. Score the answer against the picture.

<style>
:root{--bg:#eef2ee;--card:#fff;--ink:#1a201c;--muted:#57605a;--accent:#2e6a47;--accent-ink:#fff;--line:#d3d9d4;--warn:#b3261e}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif}
main{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px 16px 40px}
.narrow{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto}
h1{font-size:1.45rem;margin:0 0 8px}p{margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--muted)}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px;margin-top:14px}
.btn{appearance:none;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 18px;font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.btn.alt{background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.progress{height:6px;background:var(--line);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;margin:8px 0 14px}.progress>i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent)}
.pic{background:#dfe3df;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:16/9}
.pic img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.trial{display:grid;gap:16px}
@media(min-width:900px){.trial{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,5fr) minmax(0,6fr);align-items:start}.trial .pic{position:sticky;top:16px}}
.item{margin-top:12px}.item:first-child{margin-top:0}.item b{display:block;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:.95rem}
.scale{display:grid;gap:4px}
.scale button{appearance:none;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 0;font:inherit;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;min-width:0}
.scale button.on{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border-color:var(--accent)}
.ends{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}
.ends span:last-child{text-align:right}
.full{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#000;z-index:10;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.full img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
label.opt{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;margin-top:6px;cursor:pointer}
.q{margin-top:18px}.q:first-child{margin-top:0}.q>b{display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
.sub{margin-top:10px}.sub>span{display:block;font-size:.95rem;margin-bottom:4px}
input[type=number],input[type=text]{font:inherit;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px}
input[type=number]{width:120px}input[type=text]{width:100%;max-width:360px}
.err{color:var(--warn);margin-top:8px;min-height:1.2em}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.credit{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px 24px;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}
</style>
</head>

<script>
(function(){
  var T=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('sned-sets').textContent), TYPES=T.types, INFO={};

  var PER=100, CHECKS=[25,50,75], FULLMS=window.__FULLMS!=null?window.__FULLMS:3000;
  var app=document.getElementById('app'), Q={}, files={}, set=null, order=[], done={}, checks=[], i=0;

  function err(m){var e=app.querySelector('.err');if(e)e.textContent=m||'';}
  function ok(r){return !(r&&r.ok===false);}
  function title(f){return f.replace(/\.[^.]+$/,'');}
  function ri(n){return Math.floor(Math.random()*n);}
  function shuffle(a){a=a.slice();for(var k=a.length-1;k>0;k--){var j=ri(k+1);var x=a[k];a[k]=a[j];a[j]=x;}return a;}
  function members(s){return T.images.filter(function(r){return r[2]===s||r[3]===s;}).map(function(r){return r[0];});}
  // Pseudo-random order: never three pictures of the same category in a row (paper's rule).
  function makeOrder(list){
    for(var tries=0;tries<500;tries++){
      var pool=shuffle(list), out=[];
      while(pool.length){
        var n=out.length, run=n>=2&&INFO[out[n-1]].type===INFO[out[n-2]].type?INFO[out[n-1]].type:-1;

    if(missing.length){app.innerHTML='<div class="narrow"><h1>Pictures missing</h1><p>'+missing.length+' of 500 pictures are missing in folder “pictures”, e.g. '+esc(missing.slice(0,5).map(function(r){return r[0];}).join(', '))+'.</p></div>';return;}

    app.innerHTML='<div class="narrow"><h1>How do these places look and feel to you?</h1><p>You will see 100 pictures of natural and urban places, one at a time. Each picture first fills the screen for 3 seconds. Then answer eight short questions about it, always in the same order. Three times you will be asked whether a picture contained a car. The whole study takes about one hour. Please use a computer or laptop if you can.</p>'+

      '<div class="q"><b>'+esc(Q.education.title)+'</b>'+radios('education')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="q"><b>'+esc(Q.nationality.title)+'</b><input type="text" id="nat" maxlength="80"></div></div>'+
      '<div class="card"><div class="q"><b>'+esc(Q.social_ladder.title)+'</b>'+buttons('ladder',10,1)+'<div class="ends"><span>1 = worst off</span><span>10 = best off</span></div></div></div>'+
      '<div class="card">'+matrix('rural_urban','isolated place in the country','middle of a city')+matrix('leisure','do not like','like very much')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="card"><label class="opt" style="margin-top:0"><input type="checkbox" id="ok"> '+esc(Q.consent.title)+'</label><div class="row"><button class="btn" id="go">Start rating</button></div><div class="err"></div></div></div>';
    bindButtons(vals);
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){
      if(!document.getElementById('ok').checked)return err('Consent is needed to continue.');
      var av=document.getElementById('age').value, age=Number(av);if(!av||!(age>=18&&age<=99))return err('Please enter your age (18–99).');
      var g=app.querySelector('input[name=gender]:checked');if(!g)return err('Please answer: Gender.');
      var e=app.querySelector('input[name=education]:checked');if(!e)return err('Please answer: education.');
      var nat=document.getElementById('nat').value.trim();if(!nat)return err('Please enter your nationality.');
      if(vals.ladder==null)return err('Please choose a rung on the ladder.');
      var ru={},le={},miss=false;
      (Q.rural_urban.rows||[]).forEach(function(r){var v=vals['rural_urban.'+r.value];if(v==null)miss=true;ru[r.value]=v;});
      (Q.leisure.rows||[]).forEach(function(r){var v=vals['leisure.'+r.value];if(v==null)miss=true;le[r.value]=v;});
      if(miss)return err('Please answer every 1–10 question.');
      var b=this;b.disabled=true;
      var s=load('set');if(!(s>=1&&s<=10))s=1+ri(10);save('set',s);
      Promise.all([SPSite.answer('consent',true),SPSite.answer('age',age),SPSite.answer('gender',g.value),SPSite.answer('education',e.value),SPSite.answer('nationality',nat.slice(0,80)),SPSite.answer('social_ladder',vals.ladder),SPSite.answer('rural_urban',ru),SPSite.answer('leisure',le),SPSite.answer('image_set',s)]).then(function(rs){
        var bad=rs.filter(function(r){return !ok(r);})[0];if(bad){b.disabled=false;return err(bad.error);}
        setup(s);i=0;next();
      });
    };
  }
  function count(){return Object.keys(done).length;}
  function next(){
    var n=count();
    for(var c=0;c<CHECKS.length;c++){if(n>=CHECKS[c]&&!checks.some(function(x){return x.after===CHECKS[c];}))return check(CHECKS[c]);}
    while(i<order.length&&done[order[i]])i++;
    if(i>=order.length)return finish();
    trial(order[i]);
  }
  function trial(f){
    var file=files[f], n=count();
    var nf=order[i+1]&&files[order[i+1]];if(nf){var im=new Image();im.src=nf.url;}
    app.innerHTML='<div class="full" id="full"><img src="'+esc(file.url)+'" alt="Picture of a place, full screen"></div>';
    window.scrollTo(0,0);
    setTimeout(function(){rate(f,n);},FULLMS);
  }
  function rate(f,n){
    var file=files[f], vals={}, dims=Q.ratings.dimensions||[];
    var items=dims.map(function(d){return '<div class="item"><b>'+esc(d.label)+'</b>'+buttons(d.id,9,1)+'<div class="ends"><span>'+esc(d.left)+'</span><span>'+esc(d.right)+'</span></div></div>';}).join('');
    app.innerHTML='<p>Picture '+(n+1)+' of '+PER+'</p><div class="progress"><i style="width:'+(100*n/PER)+'%"></i></div>'+
      '<div class="trial"><div class="pic"><img src="'+esc(file.url)+'" alt="Picture of a place"></div><div><div class="card" style="margin-top:0">'+items+'</div><div class="row"><button class="btn" id="nx">Next</button></div><div class="err"></div></div></div>';
    bindButtons(vals);
    document.getElementById('nx').onclick=function(){
      if(dims.some(function(d){return vals[d.id]==null;}))return err('Please answer all eight questions.');
      var bt=this;bt.disabled=true;var v={};dims.forEach(function(d){v[d.id]=vals[d.id];});
      SPSite.answer('ratings',v,{key:title(f),shown:[f]}).then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){bt.disabled=false;return err(r.error);}done[f]=true;i++;next();});
    };
  }
  function check(after){
    var rated=order.filter(function(f){return done[f];}), used=checks.map(function(x){return x.file;});
    var pool=rated.filter(function(f){return used.indexOf(f)<0;});
    var wantUrban=after!==50, CTRL=TYPES.indexOf('Control');
    var pref=pool.filter(function(f){return (INFO[f].type===CTRL)===wantUrban;});
    var src=pref.length?pref:pool, f=src[ri(src.length)]||rated[0];
    app.innerHTML='<div class="narrow"><h1>Quick check</h1><div class="pic"><img src="'+esc(files[f].url)+'" alt="Picture of a place"></div><div class="card"><b>Does this picture contain a car?</b><div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn alt" data-a="yes">Yes</button><button class="btn alt" data-a="no">No</button></div><div class="err"></div></div></div>';
    window.scrollTo(0,0);
    app.querySelectorAll('[data-a]').forEach(function(b){b.onclick=function(){
      app.querySelectorAll('[data-a]').forEach(function(x){x.disabled=true;});
      var v={after:after,image:title(f),file:f,answer:b.getAttribute('data-a')};
      SPSite.answer('awareness_checks',v,{key:'after_'+after,shown:[f]}).then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){app.querySelectorAll('[data-a]').forEach(function(x){x.disabled=false;});return err(r.error);}checks.push(v);next();});
    };});
  }
  function finish(){
    app.innerHTML='<div class="narrow"><h1>Thank you!</h1><div class="card"><p id="fin">Submitting…</p><div class="err"></div></div></div>';
    SPSite.complete().then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){err(r.error||'Some answers are missing.');var m=r.missing||[];setTimeout(function(){if(m.some(function(x){return ['ratings','awareness_checks','image_set'].indexOf(x)<0;}))intro();else{i=0;next();}},1800);}else{var s=document.getElementById('fin');if(s)s.textContent='Your answers are saved.';}});
  }
  SPSite.onReady(function(ctx){
    ['consent','age','gender','education','nationality','social_ladder','rural_urban','leisure','image_set','ratings','awareness_checks'].forEach(function(n){Q[n]=SPSite.getQuestion(n)||{};});
    (SPSite.getMedia('pictures')||[]).forEach(function(f){files[f.name]=f;});
    var a=(ctx&&ctx.answers)||{};
    if(a.consent===true&&a.image_set>=1&&a.image_set<=10){
      setup(Number(a.image_set));
      var p=a.ratings;(p&&Array.isArray(p.trials)?p.trials:[]).forEach(function(x){if(x&&x.key!=null&&x.value!=null){var f=order.filter(function(o){return title(o)===String(x.key);})[0];if(f)done[f]=true;}});
      var ac=a.awareness_checks;(ac&&Array.isArray(ac.trials)?ac.trials:[]).forEach(function(x){if(x&&x.value&&x.value.after)checks.push(x.value);});
      i=0;next();
    }else intro();
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

config.description: Each participant rates 100 of the 500 pictures of the Salford Nature Environments Database (435 nature scenes: water, woodland, desert, field, mountain, snow, managed landscape, cave; 65 urban control scenes) on eight 9-point bipolar scales: arousal, valence, approach/avoidance, pleasantness, familiarity, mystery, interest and prospect/refuge. Each picture is first shown full screen for 3 s. The 500 pictures are split into the paper's 10 overlapping sets of 100, so every picture appears in two sets. Rebuilt from Bendall, Royle, Dodds, Watmough, Gillman, Beevers, Cassidy, Short, Metcalfe, Lomas, Graham-Kevan and Gregory (2024), Behavior Research Methods, with the authors' CC0 image set.

paper.title: The Salford Nature Environments Database (SNED): an open-access database of standardized high-quality pictures from natural environments
